Team —

This is the day-of thread for DEAL-8791 (BigCo). I want to pull everyone into one place to confirm ledger line items, final PO timings, and the contract/AM handoff. Key asks below — please reply inline with a yes/no and any blockers: 

- David: final ARR recognition bucket and invoicing date (we need the accounting cut-off for Nov).
- Priyom: are there commercial redlines outstanding in the MAP that would change billing terms?
- Laura: finance needs the settled stage and expected invoice amount for the ERP entry.
- Ben: any outstanding procurement docs from the customer (PO or internal approvals)?

I attached a fresh Q4_commit_matrix_v3.xlsx with the suggested ledger rows and a copy of the MAP_redlines_v2.pdf showing last edits. I’m tagging Sarah here so BigCo sees the cadence; Sarah, if anything has changed on your side pls flag.

Goal: close this deal in our books by EOD today and hand off to AM and billing. Reply with status and ETA.

Thanks,
